title: Suggestion
description: AI proposes, user disposes. Two shapes: a per-save folder suggestion (below threshold => review queue) and a cluster proposal (cluster-then-propose: >=3 saves in one similarity cluster with no folder => propose once; rejects stick — capturing the dismissed proposal lets the server honor that).

cluster.description: Cluster shape: member save previews, as shown on the proposal screen.

dismissed_at.description: Present on rejected proposals; never re-proposed after this.
